name: Devil Su*ner: Rai*dou vs Shokushu Ou
original_name: デビルサ●ナー・ライ●ウvs触手王
source:
To rescue Nagi who is captured by a demon named tentacle king, Raidou and Goto go to a damnatory mansion.
In the mansion, there are many traps which have the aphrodisiac effect.
